metadata.title: Zenith Professional Seed: The Complete Civilizational Roster
metadata.notes: The final, exhaustive mapping of reputable global industry standards.

nodes.title: GWO Basic Safety Training (BST)
nodes.description: The global standard for wind energy safety. Working at heights, fire awareness, and manual handling for offshore and onshore wind technicians.

nodes.title: AWS Certified Welder (SMAW/GTAW)
nodes.description: Professional welding standards. Structural steel, pipe welding, and safety. Essential for industrial assembly and foundry operations.

nodes.title: EPA Section 608 Universal
nodes.description: Regulatory certification for the handling of refrigerants. High-pressure and low-pressure system safety and environmental protection.

nodes.title: CFA Level 1 (Financial Science Mapping)
nodes.description: Elite financial standards. Ethics, professional standards, quantitative methods, economics, and financial statement analysis.

nodes.title: Professional Scrum Master (PSM I)
nodes.description: Agile leadership and empirical process control. The Scrum framework, roles, events, and artifacts. Mapping pod-facilitation to Agile standards.

edges.rationale: General solar energy fundamentals provide the electrical safety baseline for wind technicians.
Digital fabrication and CNC work provide the mechanical intuition for advanced welding.
Passive atmospheric management is the theoretical prerequisite for professional HVAC certification.
Mutual credit and value topology training provide the systemic foundation for CFA financial analysis.
Leading a sovereign pod charter is a direct application of Scrum servant-leadership principles.
